_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate is 3% directional break in 12h windows and neither brain can name the breaker that unlocks a trend — analyst correctly requires ETF flow resumption or DXY below 99, neither of which is present.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both land on Anxiety and HOLD direction, but Narrative frames it as pre-rally accumulation (bullish lean) while Analyst frames it as structural weakness with no institutional bid (bearish lean); the HOLD is consensus but the bias split is material.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn meaningfully positive OR DXY breaks below 99
next_move.invalidated_if: Sharp forced-selling cascade drops score below 24 into confirmed Panic, or VIX spikes above 70 triggering liquidation cascade
